title: 出口重量核对与限时放行谈判
english: Export weight reconciliation under dispatch pressure

modules.title: 发音热身
modules.hint: 8分钟：慢速朗读三遍；重读 reconciliation、provisional、authorization；闭眼复述。
lines: Reconciliation
对账核对
Provisional acceptance
暂定验收
Documentary evidence
单证证据
Consignee instruction
收货人指令
Release authorization
放行授权
Partial shipment
部分装运
Traceability reference
溯源参考编号
Corrective action
纠正措施

modules.title: 10高频词/短语
modules.hint: 8分钟：逐条朗读、解释并用英语造句。
lines: Document mismatch
单证不匹配
Commercial invoice
商业发票
Packing list
装箱单
Certificate of origin
原产地证书
Export permit
出口许可证
Batch reconciliation
批次核对
Verified net weight
已核实净重
Conditional release
有条件放行
Supporting evidence
支持性证据
Written approval
书面批准

modules.title: 10核心句
modules.hint: 10分钟：先按中文翻译成英文，再对照纠错。
lines: The invoice quantity does not agree with the packing list.
发票数量与装箱单不一致。
Please identify which document contains the verified figure.
请指出哪份单证载有已核实的数据。
We cannot amend the certificate without supporting evidence.
没有支持性证据，我们不能修改证书。
The customs broker has requested a corrected document set.
报关代理要求提供修订后的整套单证。
Keep the cargo sealed until the discrepancy is resolved.
在差异解决前保持货物封存。
Please confirm the batch references against the warehouse register.
请将批次参考编号与仓库登记簿核对。
We can discuss a revised dispatch schedule after verification.
核验后我们可以讨论调整发运时间表。
A verbal instruction is not sufficient for release.
口头指令不足以授权放行。
The payment status must be confirmed separately from customs clearance.
付款状态必须与海关放行分别确认。
Please provide a written decision by two p.m. Kigali time.
请在基加利时间下午两点前提供书面决定。

modules.title: 金额/吨位/品位/汇率口述
modules.english: Numbers, weights, grades and exchange rates
modules.hint: 7分钟：以下数字完全虚构。先遮住英文，口述数值，再说明干湿重不能混用。
lines: The illustrative gross weight is twelve point eight metric tonnes.
示例毛重为12.8公吨。
The packaging weighs zero point three metric tonnes.
包装重量为0.3公吨。
The illustrative net weight is twelve point five metric tonnes.
示例净重为12.5公吨。
The declared grade is thirty-one point two percent tantalum pentoxide.
申报的示例五氧化二钽品位为31.2%。
The invoice lists twelve point four tonnes, which is zero point one tonne less than the verified net weight.
发票列12.4吨，比核实净重少0.1吨。
The illustrative invoice value is forty-two thousand six hundred US dollars.
示例发票金额为42600美元。
For this exercise only, one US dollar equals one thousand four hundred and eighty Rwandan francs.
仅在本练习中，1美元按1480卢旺达法郎计算。
At that assumed rate, the invoice value is sixty-three million forty-eight thousand Rwandan francs.
按该假设汇率，发票金额为63048000卢旺达法郎。
A difference of one hundred kilograms requires reconciliation before release.
100公斤差异须在放行前核对。

modules.title: Shadowing
modules.hint: 6分钟：每句慢速跟读三遍、正常速度两遍，最后连读。
lines: Our warehouse records show a verified net weight that differs from the commercial invoice.
仓库记录的已核实净重与商业发票不同。
We have isolated the affected batch and requested a corrected document set.
我们已隔离受影响批次并要求修订整套单证。
We will authorize dispatch only after the weight, batch reference and export documents are reconciled.
只有重量、批次编号和出口单证核对一致后才会授权发运。
The buyer's deadline does not override our documentary controls.
买方的截止时间不能凌驾于单证控制之上。

modules.title: Small Talk
modules.hint: 3分钟：两人轮流对话，不直接从寒暄跳到指责。
lines: Did you have any difficulty reaching the warehouse this morning?
今天早上到仓库路上遇到困难了吗？
There was a short delay, but everyone arrived safely.
有一点延误，但大家都安全抵达。
Would you like to review the shipment file together?
要不要一起核对装运档案？
Yes, that should help us identify the source of the difference.
好，这有助于我们找出差异来源。
Thank you for helping us keep the shipment compliant.
感谢协助确保本批货物合规。

modules.title: 矿业业务沟通
modules.hint: 7分钟：练习采购、仓储、财务三方会议；分清数量核对、付款和审批。
lines: Procurement: The supplier says the invoice weight was estimated before final weighing.
采购：供应商称发票重量是在最终称重前估算的。
Warehouse: Our signed scale record confirms twelve point five tonnes net.
仓储：签字的称重记录确认净重为12.5吨。
Finance: We must not change the payable amount until the contract basis is confirmed.
财务：确认合同计价依据前不能修改应付金额。
Compliance: Please preserve the original invoice and document the correction history.
合规：请保留原发票并记录修改历史。
Buyer: We can accept a revised document set if it accurately reflects the verified cargo.
买方：若修订单证准确反映已核实货物，我们可以接受。
Meeting chair: Assign one owner to reconcile the records and another to approve the final release.
主持人：指定一人核对记录，另一人审批最终放行。

modules.title: 运输押运/海关
modules.hint: 6分钟：模拟司机在出口窗口排队、海关代理要求更改单证。
lines: Driver: The truck is waiting at the designated holding area.
司机：车辆正在指定待命区等候。
Escort: The seal is intact, and its number matches the dispatch register.
押运：封签完好，号码与发运登记簿一致。
Broker: Customs has requested clarification of the net weight.
代理：海关要求澄清净重。
Logistics: Do not move the truck until the authorized release is received.
物流：收到正式放行授权前不要移动车辆。
Broker: Please provide the corrected invoice and packing list together.
代理：请同时提供修订后的发票和装箱单。
Compliance: Never backdate a document or invent a weight to clear the queue.
合规：不得为通过排队审核而倒签文件或虚构重量。

modules.title: 15分钟高压角色扮演
modules.hint: 15分钟：每轮5分钟；每轮先即兴回应，再读示范，最后脱稿重答。三项压力均须作出决定。
lines: Decision one: The buyer threatens to cancel unless the truck departs within ten minutes.
决策一：买方威胁若车辆十分钟内不出发就取消订单。
Model response: I understand the urgency, but dispatch requires verified documents and written authorization. I can give you an updated timeline within thirty minutes.
示范回答：我理解紧迫性，但发运须有核实的单证和书面授权。我可以在30分钟内更新进度。
Decision two: The supplier asks you to replace the signed weight record with the invoice figure.
决策二：供应商要求用发票数字替换已签字称重记录。
Model response: We cannot alter an original measurement. We will preserve it, investigate the discrepancy, and issue a documented correction if justified.
示范回答：不能修改原始测量记录。我们将保留原件、调查差异，并在有依据时形成书面更正。
Decision three: The broker suggests backdating the export document to meet a customs deadline.
决策三：代理建议倒签出口文件以赶上海关截止时间。
Model response: We will not backdate documents. Please request a lawful extension and submit the accurate corrected documents.
示范回答：我们不会倒签文件。请依法申请延期并提交准确的修订单证。
Follow-up challenge: The bank asks whether the corrected invoice changes the beneficiary.
追问压力：银行询问修订发票是否改变收款人。
Model response: No beneficiary change has been approved. Payment instructions remain subject to independent verification.
示范回答：未批准任何收款人变更。付款指令仍须独立核验。

modules.title: 5句听写
modules.hint: 3分钟：只听英文并手写；随后核对拼写与介词。
lines: The net weight must match the supporting records.
净重必须与支持记录一致。
Please preserve the original invoice.
请保留原始发票。
We cannot approve a verbal release instruction.
我们不能批准口头放行指令。
The broker requested a corrected packing list.
代理要求修订装箱单。
The truck will remain at the holding area.
车辆将继续停在待命区。

modules.title: 5道口语题
modules.hint: 3分钟：每题30秒，采用决定—理由—下一步结构。
lines: How would you explain a weight mismatch to the buyer?
如何向买方解释重量差异？
What evidence should be preserved before correcting an invoice?
修改发票前应保存哪些证据？
How would you respond to pressure to release a truck without written approval?
面对没有书面批准就要求放车的压力，你如何回应？
Why must payment verification remain separate from customs clearance?
为何付款核验必须与海关放行分开？
What would you say to a broker who proposes backdating a certificate?
代理建议倒签证书时你会怎么说？

modules.title: 前三课复习
modules.english: Review of the last three lessons
modules.hint: 3分钟：复习Day31至33，并说明今日新增的重量差异处理。
lines: Day thirty-one: Verify the consignee before issuing release instructions.
第31课：发出放行指令前核实收货人。
Day thirty-two: Do not backdate traceability records to satisfy a deadline.
第32课：不能为赶期限倒签溯源记录。
Day thirty-three: Segregate moisture-affected material and verify the payable dry weight.
第33课：隔离受潮物料并核实应付干重。
Today: Reconcile invoice weight, packing-list weight and the signed scale record.
今天：核对发票重量、装箱单重量及签字称重记录。

modules.title: 完整工作陈述
modules.hint: 4分钟：先逐句朗读，再完整汇报，最后用90秒脱稿讲述。
lines: Good morning. I am reporting a documentary discrepancy affecting a mineral export shipment.
早上好。我汇报一批矿产品出口货物的单证差异。
The signed warehouse scale record shows a net weight of twelve point five tonnes, while the commercial invoice states twelve point four tonnes.
签字仓库称重记录显示净重12.5吨，而商业发票写12.4吨。
These figures are illustrative, but the control procedure is realistic.
这些数字为教学示例，但控制程序贴近实际。
The cargo remains sealed in the designated holding area, and the escort team has confirmed the seal number.
货物仍封存在指定待命区，押运团队已确认封签号码。
We have asked procurement to confirm the contractual weight basis and logistics to reconcile the packing list and dispatch records.
我们已要求采购确认合同重量依据，物流核对装箱单及发运记录。
The original documents will be preserved, and any justified correction will be clearly dated and approved.
原始单证将保留，任何有依据的更正都将如实注明日期并获得批准。
We will not backdate a certificate, invent a measurement, or release the truck on a verbal instruction.
我们不会倒签证书、虚构测量数据或依据口头指令放车。
Finance will separately verify whether the corrected invoice affects the payment amount or beneficiary information.
财务将另行核实修订发票是否影响付款金额或收款人信息。
We will update the buyer in writing and provide a realistic dispatch schedule after the documents have been reconciled.
单证核对后，我们将书面更新买方并提供切实可行的发运时间表。
Thank you. I am ready to answer questions from the buyer, broker and compliance team.
谢谢。我愿意回答买方、代理和合规团队的问题。

modules.title: 完成清单
modules.hint: 总计约75分钟。按真实计时完成；未完成部分留待复习。
lines: Pronunciation and vocabulary: sixteen minutes.
发音和词汇：16分钟。
Core sentences and numbers: seventeen minutes.
核心句与数字：17分钟。
Shadowing and small talk: nine minutes.
跟读与寒暄：9分钟。
Mining operations and transport: thirteen minutes.
矿业业务与运输：13分钟。
High-pressure role-play: fifteen minutes.
高压角色扮演：15分钟。
Dictation, speaking, review and briefing: use the remaining practice time and revisit difficult items.
听写、口语、复习和陈述：利用剩余练习时间并复练难点。
State three decisions in English: hold dispatch, preserve records, and reject backdating.
用英语明确三个决定：暂停发运、保留记录、拒绝倒签。
